title: GRIPFinding
description: A verified security finding surfaced in the ACT step. Only findings that passed the verification gate with corroborated=true appear in the output. Each finding carries the full evidence chain linking the violated rule to the specific property and its current value.

ruleId.description: Identifier of the primary rule that detected the violation.

propertyPath.description: The resource property path affected by this finding. May be a full JSON pointer or a property name for absent-property violations.

actualValue.description: The current value of the affected property. 'NOT SET' indicates the property is absent from the resource.

expected.description: The remediation action or expected constraint.

relatedRules.description: Additional rule IDs that flagged the same property and were deduplicated into this finding. Present only when deduplication occurred.
